metadata.title: Contact
metadata.description: Get in touch with Francisco Cruz. Available for analytics engineering engagements, frontend development contracts, and martech consulting.

blocks.heading: Let's talk about your project.
blocks.subtext: Available for analytics engineering engagements, frontend development contracts, and martech consulting retainers. I respond to every message within one business day.

items.question: What types of engagements do you take on?
items.answer: I work on analytics architecture builds, martech migrations, tracking governance frameworks, A/B testing programmes, and frontend development projects. I'm comfortable working solo, embedding in an existing engineering team, or providing technical leadership across multiple squads. Minimum engagement length is typically 4 weeks.

items.question: What tools and platforms do you specialise in?
items.answer: My core stack is Tealium, Adobe Experience Cloud (Analytics, Target, Launch), Google Stack (GA4, GTM, BigQuery), and oneTrust. On the frontend side: React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). I also have hands-on experience with Braze, AppsFlyer, Meta Pixel, Google Ads, Hotjar, Looker, and server-side tagging architectures.

items.question: What is your availability and time zone?
items.answer: I'm based in Madrid, Spain (CET/CEST). I work standard European business hours and can accommodate daily overlap with teams in US time zones when planned ahead. Reach out to discuss current availability.

items.question: Do you have experience with regulated industries or sensitive data?
items.answer: Yes. I've worked in digital health and financial services contexts, and I follow GDPR-aligned data handling practices. I have deep experience integrating consent management platforms (oneTrust) into data collection architectures and designing governance frameworks that satisfy compliance requirements without breaking the analytics stack.
